entry.title: v0.11.0
entry.content:
Velero UI v0.11.0 : Security hardening, dedicated health probes and Simplified Chinese support

This release strengthens authentication and authorization, secures log rendering, improves Kubernetes health checks, and adds Simplified Chinese translations. It also includes Helm chart v1.0.0.

⚠️ Upgrade requirements

This release introduces configuration and API changes. Review the following before upgrading:

  • Configure AUTH_SECRET_PASSPHRASE with a random value of at least 32 bytes. Default signing keys have been removed. Generate a key with openssl rand -hex 32.
  • If local authentication is enabled, explicitly configure BASIC_AUTH_USERNAME and BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD. Default credentials are removed, and the password admin is rejected. For SSO-only installations, set BASIC_AUTH_ENABLED=false.
  • Configure explicit RBAC permissions for SSO/LDAP users. Missing or empty policies grant no permissions; an unreadable configured file or an invalid rule prevents startup.
  • Replace custom /health checks with /health/live, /health/startup or /health/ready.
  • Update API clients that submit undeclared fields or use the old sciSnapshotTimeout and dataMover spellings. Use csiSnapshotTimeout and datamover.
  • Upgrade the frontend and API together to include the corrected bulk-download request format.

Existing Velero backups, restores and schedules require no resource migration. Rotating the JWT signing key requires restarting the application and signing in again.

Security

  • Removed built-in JWT signing keys from the API configuration and Docker image.
  • Removed implicit local administrator credentials and added startup validation.
  • Removed automatic administrator permissions when federated RBAC policies are missing or invalid.
  • Fixed a cross-site scripting vulnerability in raw log rendering. Log content is now rendered as text while preserving search highlighting.
  • Required the download permission for bulk backup downloads, matching individual downloads.
  • Enabled strict validation for DTO-bound API requests. Unknown fields, including execution hooks submitted through backup, schedule and restore requests, are rejected.
  • Excluded local environment files and deployment values from Git tracking rules, and environment files from Docker build contexts.

API and interface fixes

  • Fixed bulk backup downloads to send an array of backup names directly, with server-side array validation.
  • Corrected backup option names to csiSnapshotTimeout and datamover.
  • Changed log search highlighting to treat special characters literally.
  • Added Simplified Chinese (zh) to the language selector.

Health checks and Kubernetes

  • Added dedicated process-health endpoints at /health/live and /health/startup.
  • Added /health/ready to check Kubernetes and Velero dependencies.
  • Separated liveness from dependency checks to avoid unnecessary restarts during dependency outages.
  • Added a configurable startup probe to the Helm chart.
  • Updated default liveness and readiness probe paths in Helm and standalone Kubernetes manifests.
  • Fixed Helm injection of AUTH_SECRET_PASSPHRASE from the configured Secret or explicit value.
  • Removed the chart’s default signing key. Helm installations must provide a value or an existing Secret.
  • Set POLICY_FILE_PATH only when chart-managed policies are enabled.
  • Updated standalone manifests to obtain signing keys and local credentials from a Kubernetes Secret.
  • Updated Artifact Hub changelog annotations.

Dependencies, CI and testing

  • Updated NestJS, Nx, UUID, Vite, Vitest and PostCSS, together with transitive dependencies.
  • Added targeted dependency overrides for security fixes.
  • Fixed missing lockfile entries that prevented clean installation with npm 10.
  • Updated CI path filters so changes to package-lock.json trigger validation.
  • Added regression coverage for authentication, RBAC, request validation, download authorization, safe log rendering, health endpoints and Helm secret configuration.

Documentation

  • Added a security configuration and migration guide.
  • Updated Docker, Helm, Kubernetes, environment-variable and RBAC instructions.
  • Added an LLDAP configuration example and clarified supported LDAP variable names.
  • Updated the README’s documented tested Velero versions to include 1.17.x and 1.18.x.

PRs

  • fix(api): split health probe checks by @jdetroyes in #142
  • feat(i18n): add Simplified Chinese (zh) locale by @TelDragon in #144
  • chore: security by @jdetroyes in #145

New Contributors

  • @TelDragon made their first contribution in #144
